description: Extract colors, typography, and spacing from the document as design tokens in CSS custom properties, JSON, or Tailwind format. Optionally writes the result to output_path (never overwrites an existing file unless overwrite: true).

output_path.description: Absolute file path to save the output (e.g. "/path/to/tokens.json"). If omitted, returns text only.

overwrite.description: Replace output_path if it already exists. Default false: an existing file is left untouched and an error is returned.

name: extract_design_tokens
title: Extract Design Tokens
